Bug_Details: == must be used in equals method to check equality to itself or an infinite loop will occur. .equals() to the same object will result in infinite recursion
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the equals method where the method calls itself recursively using this.equals(that) instead of comparing fields or using == for self-reference.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling assertEquals on two instances of EqualsReferenceBug. The equals method in the buggy class incorrectly calls itself recursively using this.equals(that), leading to infinite recursion and a StackOverflowError.
Test_Run_Result: Runninng test will fail system because of infinite loop.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results indicate that the test failed due to an infinite loop, which confirms that the bug was triggered.
